nmap_command.description: The default Nmap command line template used for standard scans. Uses $TARGET as a placeholder for the user-specified target.

profiles.description: A list of scan profiles to make available in the Zenmap interface. Each item contains a name and the Nmap arguments string.

profiles.items.description: Not used directly. See fields below.

profile_name.description: The name of the scan profile as it appears in the Zenmap UI.

profile_args.description: The Nmap command-line arguments associated with the profile.

disable_crash_reporting.description: If true, sets the ZENMAP_DEVELOPMENT environment variable to disable automatic crash reporting.

default_target.description: The default network target (IP address or hostname) pre-filled in the target field when Zenmap starts.
